steps.say: AI agents can now spend your money. But when a charge is disputed, who can prove what the agent was allowed to do? That is the problem Sentry solves.
Picture a helper robot doing your shopping. Sentry gives it a signed permission slip, a strict checker, and a notebook that cannot be quietly changed.
Let us see it work. First, the mandate: a signed rulebook for the agent.
Two hundred dollars a month, groceries only, and anything above seventy-five dollars waits for your approval.
Every mandate is signed, and one click checks the signature.
Now we tell the agent what to buy, in plain English.
It picks an item, the checker confirms it fits the mandate, and a PayPal sandbox order is created.
Every choice lands in the ledger, with its mandate check beside it.

steps.click: text=Demo: let the agent break its mandate
steps.say: Now the honest part. A clearly labelled demo switch lets the agent break its own rules.

steps.highlight: text=Outside mandate: category not allowed, exceeds monthly cap
steps.say: The record still tells the truth: wrong category, over the cap.
